candidate_program.name: density_adaptive
candidate_program.rationale: Continuously shifts from count efficiency toward weighted capture as the root blocks more of the active set. Uses local aggregates and residual size; arithmetic is constant-size, but neither component knows neighborhood topology and base refresh costs remain.
candidate_program.rule: (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count)) * weight / (1 + degree) + degree / (1 + remaining_count) * weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
